TABLE.NAME: local_zoomattendance_occ
TABLE.COMMENT: Scheduled or inferred occurrences of a Zoom activity, snapshotted so past schedules survive mod_zoom calendar rewrites.

FIELD.NAME: zoomid
FIELD.COMMENT: The zoom.id of the activity instance.

FIELD.NAME: occurrencekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Calendar event uuid, 'single', 'p:' plus the start for regular-time ones, 's:' plus a hash for inferred ones, or 'm:' plus a hash for manual ones.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: schedule, pattern (regular meeting time), inferred, or manual (window set by a teacher).

FIELD.NAME: timestart
FIELD.COMMENT: Window start.

FIELD.NAME: timeend
FIELD.COMMENT: Window end.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 active, 1 cancelled upstream, 2 excluded by a teacher, 3 before a reset of the course's Zoom data.

FIELD.NAME: actualsecs
FIELD.COMMENT: Length of the union of mapped session spans inside the window.

FIELD.NAME: timecomputed
FIELD.COMMENT: When results were last recomputed.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who last excluded, included or set the window of the occurrence (0 for the sync).

FIELD.NAME: excludereason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the occurrence was excluded.

FIELD.NAME: rosterfrozen
FIELD.COMMENT: When the expected students and teachers were frozen in local_zoomattendance_roster (0 while still live, -1 when left live for good: see roster::DEFERRED).

FIELD.NAME: restored
FIELD.COMMENT: When the occurrence was restored from a backup. Restored occurrences keep their stored results: the Zoom sessions they came from are not in the backup.

TABLE.NAME: local_zoomattendance_session
TABLE.COMMENT: Sync bookkeeping: which mod_zoom session maps to which occurrence, and the data fingerprint last processed.

FIELD.NAME: detailsid
FIELD.COMMENT: The zoom_meeting_details.id of the session.

FIELD.NAME: occurrenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Mapped occurrence, null if not mapped.

TABLE.NAME: local_zoomattendance_result
TABLE.COMMENT: Attended time per occurrence and participant identity. Absent users have no row.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Matched Moodle user, null for unmatched Zoom participants.

FIELD.NAME: identitykey
FIELD.COMMENT: u:userid, or z: plus a hash for unmatched participants.

FIELD.NAME: displayname
FIELD.COMMENT: Zoom display name, only for unmatched participants.

FIELD.NAME: matchstrength
FIELD.COMMENT: 2 email match, 1 other match, 0 unmatched.

TABLE.NAME: local_zoomattendance_roster
TABLE.COMMENT: The students and teachers expected at an occurrence, frozen once it is over, so later enrolment changes do not rewrite past attendance.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: student or teacher.

FIELD.NAME: groupids
FIELD.COMMENT: The course groups the user was in when the list was frozen, as ,3,7, (empty for none).

TABLE.NAME: local_zoomattendance_teacher
TABLE.COMMENT: Teachers responsible for an activity. Without rows every teacher of the course is expected.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who chose the teacher.

TABLE.NAME: local_zoomattendance_setting
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-activity overrides. Null fields inherit the site defaults.

TABLE.NAME: local_zoomattendance_idmap
TABLE.COMMENT: Teacher-confirmed links from an unmatched Zoom participant identity to a Moodle user, per course.

FIELD.NAME: identitykey
FIELD.COMMENT: The z: identity key of the unmatched participant.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Moodle user the identity belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: displayname
FIELD.COMMENT: Zoom display name when the link was made, for reference.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who made the link.
